segments.an5.143:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.an5.143:1.2: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.an5.143:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena pañcamattānaṃ licchavisatānaṃ sārandade cetiye sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.an5.143:1.6: Hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, assaratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, itthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.143:1.7: Imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin”ti.
segments.an5.143:2.1: Atha kho te licchavī magge purisaṃ ṭhapesuṃ [pesesuṃ (syā. ka.)]–
segments.an5.143:2.2: “yadā tvaṃ [yathā tvaṃ (sī. pī.)], ambho purisa, passeyyāsi bhagavantaṃ, atha amhākaṃ āroceyyāsī”ti.
segments.an5.143:2.3: Addasā kho so puriso bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ;
segments.an5.143:2.4: disvāna yena te licchavī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā te licchavī etadavoca –
segments.an5.143:2.5: “ayaṃ so, bhante, bhagavā gacchati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho;
segments.an5.143:3.1: Atha kho te licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te licchavī bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an5.143:4.1: “Sādhu, bhante, yena sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.143:4.3: Atha kho bhagavā yena sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho bhagavā te licchavī etadavoca –
segments.an5.143:4.4: “kāya nuttha, licchavī, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā”ti?
segments.an5.143:4.5: “Idha, bhante, amhākaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.an5.143:4.8: Hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, assaratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, itthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.143:4.9: Imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin’”ti.
segments.an5.143:5.1: “Kāmādhimuttānaṃ vata, bho, licchavīnaṃ [kāmādhimuttānaṃ vata vo licchavīnaṃ (sī.), kāmādhimuttānaṃ vata vo licchavī (syā.), kāmādhimuttānaṃva vo licchavī (?)] kāmaṃyeva ārabbha antarākathā udapādi.
segments.an5.143:5.2: Pañcannaṃ, licchavī, ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.143:5.4: Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā [viññātassa (sī. pī.) a. ni.5.195] dhammānudhammappaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, kataññū katavedī puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.143:5.9: Imesaṃ kho, licchavī, pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin”ti.

lines: Dhammānudhammappaṭipannoti navalokuttaradhammatthāya sahasīlakaṃ pubbabhāgappaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno paṭipattipūrako puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
